correctness.rationale: Exact welfare normalization, disconnected-component separation, and matching domination for paths/even cycles and cyclically averaged matchings for odd cycles prove all coalition sizes >=4 can be replaced. The O(n) three-tile path recurrence and six fixed-vertex cycle cases are exhaustive, with separate triangle enumeration. Independent brute force examined 2209 connected signed-weight cases and 580 disconnected instances, plus P3/claw sharpness; finite tests are not the proof.

value.rationale: An exact structural and algorithmic theorem for the natural complete class of maximum-degree-two coalition networks, under unrestricted signed and heterogeneous valuations, removes pseudopolynomial weight dependence and yields a witness in strongly linear real arithmetic. The P3/claw examples show the coalition-size bound and degree boundary are sharp. This is a meaningful classification and complexity improvement, not merely re-expression of unweighted stars.
